# Third-party notices

This preliminary package covers Stockfish only. See `ATTRIBUTION.md`, `AUTHORS`, and `COPYING`.

The measured native candidate was built with the official GCC image pinned in `BUILD.md` and compatibility-probed in the pinned Debian image recorded there. Exact compiler, linker, libc, libstdc++, executable, and runtime identities are recorded in `BUILD.md` and `PROVENANCE.json`.

The local service image recipe and immutable input identities are recorded in `BUILD.md` and `PROVENANCE.json`. Final image, SBOM, and vulnerability-report digests are recorded externally to avoid a self-referential image build. The corresponding-source recipient location, retention period, and final release approval remain pending. They must be completed and reviewed before publication, deployment, or distribution.
